# UselessUnset

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Unused](/rules/#unused) · PhpStorm name: `UselessUnsetInspection`

Calling `unset()` on a function parameter only destroys the function's local
binding: the caller's value (whether passed by value or by reference) is
unaffected, and the local goes away at return anyway. Such an `unset()` is
almost always pointless.

## Example

```php{9,10,12,13,33}
<?php
function consume(array &$queue, $item, ...$rest)
{
    static $seen;
    global $registry;

    unset($queue['head']);
    unset($seen, $registry);
    unset($item);
    unset($seen, $rest);
    unset(
        $queue,
        $item
    );

    foreach ($registry as $entry) {
        unset($entry);
    }

    $later = function () use ($item) {
        unset($item);
    };

    return;
    unset($item);
}

class Pool
{
    public function release($handle)
    {
        $handle = null;
        unset($handle);
    }
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 9: Unsetting a parameter only drops the local variable; this unset() is pointless.</li>
<li>line 10: Unsetting a parameter only drops the local variable; this unset() is pointless.</li>
<li>line 12: Unsetting a parameter only drops the local variable; this unset() is pointless.</li>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UselessUnset": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UselessUnset

/**
 * @noinspection UselessUnsetInspection
 */
```
